name: Riverscape Restoration Initiative
summary: Grants for low-tech, process-based and beaver-based restoration of streams and watersheds in the arid southwestern United States and northern Mexico, with smaller grants for capacity and landowner engagement.

amount.note: Implementation grants are $50,000 to $100,000; capacity grants go up to $25,000 and engagement grants up to $7,500.

status.quote: The deadline for proposals is March 31, 2026.

deadline.quote: The deadline for proposals is March 31, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Proposals may be submitted by registered nonprofit organizations, civil society organizations, and Native American tribes in the geographic area described above.

geography.quote: improve the resilience of watersheds in arid and semi-arid regions of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico

access.quote: Email completed proposal as a PDF or Word document to Jennifer Gooden at jennifer@biophiliafoundation.org.

amount.quote: Implementation: Grants of $50,000 to $100,000 are available for projects that implement low-tech, process-based, and/or beaver-based restoration of upland streams and watersheds.
